objective: Stage-2 support for Typeless's 隨便問 (ask-anything) mode and context-aware formatting, without touching desktop.py. (1) voice2txt/translation.py: `instructions(mode, vocabulary='', context=None)` where context is an optional dict {app, title, selection, category} rendered as a short trailing block ('Output destination: <app> (<category>) — window: <title>'; 'Selected text in the target field:\n<selection>' when present, selection truncated to 2000 chars); add TASKS['ask']: the transcript is a spoken question or instruction; answer it directly and concisely in the same language as the transcript (Traditional Chinese for Chinese, English for English); if selected text is provided and the instruction refers to it (rewrite, translate, summarise, fix, answer about it), apply the instruction to that text and output only the result; never add preamble, quotes or explanations; output must be ready to paste. For 'ask', RULES (the ASR clean-up rules) are still prepended because the input is ASR text, but the task text overrides the 'return the text unchanged' rule. For zh/en/translate, when context is given add one line: if category is 'code' keep plain text without markdown; if 'email' or 'document' keep paragraphs; if 'chat' keep it short. All backends' `refine(text, mode, vocabulary='', context=None)` pass context through; `decode_segment(..., context=None)`: for mode 'ask' transcribe with zh (unless the dictation language is en, pass `ask_language` param default 'zh'), then refine with context; if the chain fails there is no Whisper fallback for 'ask': return DecodeResult(source, source, backend='Whisper', warning='沒有可用的 LLM，顯示原始轉錄') (not an error). (2) New voice2txt/context.py (Win32, ctypes only): `foreground_window()` -> hwnd; `window_info(hwnd)` -> {hwnd, title, process_name, exe_path} via GetWindowTextW, GetWindowThreadProcessId, OpenProcess+QueryFullProcessImageNameW; `categorize(process_name, title)` pure, using a small table (browsers chrome/msedge/firefox -> 'browser'; outlook/thunderbird/mail titles -> 'email'; code/devenv/pycharm/idea/windowsterminal/powershell/cmd -> 'code'; teams/slack/discord/line/telegram/whatsapp -> 'chat'; winword/excel/powerpnt/notion/obsidian/notepad -> 'document'; else 'other'); `capture_selection(hwnd, timeout=0.4)` saves the current clipboard text (CF_UNICODETEXT only; record `had_other_formats` when the clipboard held non-text formats), sends Ctrl+C via SendInput with the hook MARKER from hotkeys.py, waits for the clipboard sequence number (GetClipboardSequenceNumber) to change up to timeout, reads the new text, then restores the saved text (or empties if it was empty); returns (selection or '', restored_ok). `foreground_context(capture=True)` combines these into the context dict. (3) tests/test_context.py for categorize and for instructions()/decode_segment with context and 'ask' (stub engine and translator, no Win32); tests/test_translation.py extended for TASKS['ask'] and the context block.
